title: Math Antics - Ratios and Rates
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics teaches ratios as comparisons of two quantities and rates as ratios with different units. Learn to write ratios, simplify them, and solve ratio problems.

title: Math Antics - Proportions
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about proportions as equivalent ratios. Use cross-multiplication to solve proportion problems. Apply proportions to real-world scenarios like scaling and recipes.

title: Math Antics - Negative Numbers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics introduces negative numbers and the concept of opposites. Learn to compare, order, and perform basic operations with positive and negative integers.

title: Math Antics - Adding and Subtracting Integers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to add and subtract positive and negative integers using number lines and rules. Same signs add, different signs subtract, keep the sign of the bigger number.

title: Math Antics - Multiplying and Dividing Integers
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the rules for multiplying and dividing integers. Same signs give positive answers, different signs give negative answers. Apply to multi-step problems.

title: Math Antics - Absolute Value
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn that absolute value is the distance from zero on the number line, always positive. Use absolute value to compare numbers and solve problems.

title: Math Antics - Decimal Place Value
subject: Mathematics
summary: Extend decimal place value understanding to thousandths. Compare, order, and round decimals. Understand the relationship between place values in decimals.

title: Math Antics - Decimal Arithmetic
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn all four operations with decimals. Line up decimal points for addition and subtraction, count decimal places for multiplication, move decimal points for division.

title: Math Antics - What Is Algebra?
subject: Mathematics
summary: Math Antics introduces algebra as using letters to represent unknown numbers. Learn about variables, constants, expressions, and equations. The foundation of algebraic thinking.

title: Math Antics - Solving Basic Equations Part 1
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to solve one-step equations using inverse operations. Addition and subtraction equations. Isolate the variable by doing the opposite operation to both sides.

title: Math Antics - Solving Basic Equations Part 2
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to solve two-step equations by undoing operations in reverse order. First undo addition/subtraction, then undo multiplication/division. Check your answer.

title: Math Antics - Mean, Median, and Mode
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to find the mean (average), median (middle), and mode (most frequent) of a data set. Understand when to use each measure and how outliers affect them.

title: Math Antics - Basic Probability
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about probability as the likelihood of an event occurring. Express probability as fractions, decimals, and percentages. Understand impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely, and certain.

title: Math Antics - Circles: What Is PI?
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about pi as the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Understand that pi is approximately 3.14 and is an irrational number that goes on forever.

title: Math Antics - Circles: Circumference and Area
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the formulas for circumference (C = pi x d) and area (A = pi x r squared) of circles. Practice finding circumference and area given radius or diameter.

title: Math Antics - Volume
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to find the volume of rectangular prisms, triangular prisms, and pyramids. Use the formula V = B x h (base area times height) for prisms.

title: Math Antics - The Pythagorean Theorem
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn the Pythagorean Theorem: a squared plus b squared equals c squared for right triangles. Use it to find missing side lengths and solve real-world problems.

title: Math Antics - The Number Line
subject: Mathematics
summary: Extend understanding of the number line to include negative numbers. Plot and compare rational numbers on the number line. Connect to the coordinate plane.

title: Math Antics - Inequalities
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about inequalities using greater than, less than, greater than or equal to, and less than or equal to. Graph inequalities on a number line and solve simple inequalities.

title: Math Antics - Data and Graphs
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to create and interpret various graphs including bar graphs, line graphs, circle graphs, and histograms. Understand how to read and analyze data displays.

title: The Scientific Method Song | Steps of Science
subject: Science
summary: Learn the steps of the scientific method - question, research, hypothesis, experiment, analyze data, and conclusion. Apply the scientific method to investigations.

title: The Photosynthesis Song | How Plants Make Food
subject: Science
summary: Learn about photosynthesis - how plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make glucose and oxygen. Understand the importance of photosynthesis for life on Earth.

title: The Cell Division Song | Mitosis
subject: Science
summary: Learn about cell division through mitosis. Understand the stages - prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase. How one cell becomes two identical daughter cells.

title: The Genetics Song | DNA and Heredity
subject: Science
summary: Learn about DNA, genes, chromosomes, and heredity. Understand how traits are passed from parents to offspring through genetic inheritance.

title: The Weather and Climate Song | What's the Difference?
subject: Science
summary: Learn the difference between weather (short-term atmospheric conditions) and climate (long-term patterns). Understand how climate is determined by latitude, altitude, and distance from water.

title: The Plate Tectonics Song | Earth's Moving Crust
subject: Science
summary: Learn about plate tectonics - how Earth's crust is divided into moving plates. Understand convergent, divergent, and transform boundaries and the landforms they create.

title: The Rock Cycle Song | Igneous, Sedimentary, Metamorphic
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the three types of rocks and how they transform through the rock cycle. Igneous rocks form from cooled magma, sedimentary from compressed sediments, metamorphic from heat and pressure.

title: The Force and Motion Song | Newton's Laws
subject: Science
summary: Learn about forces, motion, speed, velocity, and acceleration. Understand Newton's three laws of motion and how they explain the movement of objects.

title: The Energy Song | Kinetic and Potential
subject: Science
summary: Learn about different forms of energy - kinetic, potential, thermal, electrical, chemical, and light. Understand the law of conservation of energy.

title: The Simple Machines Song | Levers, Pulleys, Wedges, and More
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the six simple machines - lever, wheel and axle, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, and screw. Understand how simple machines make work easier.

subject: Science
summary: Learn about the circulatory system - the heart, blood, and blood vessels. Understand how blood carries oxygen and nutrients throughout the body.

title: The Respiratory System Song | Breathing and Lungs
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the respiratory system - how we breathe and how lungs work. Understand the path of air from nose to alveoli and the gas exchange process.

title: The Digestive System Song | From Mouth to Intestines
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the digestive system - how food travels from mouth to intestines. Understand the role of each organ in breaking down food and absorbing nutrients.

title: The Nervous System Song | Brain, Spinal Cord, and Nerves
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the nervous system - the brain, spinal cord, and nerves. Understand how electrical signals travel through the body to control movement, thought, and sensation.

title: The Muscular System Song | How Muscles Work
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the muscular system - skeletal, smooth, and cardiac muscles. Understand how muscles contract and relax to produce movement.

title: The Solar System Song | Planets, Moons, and Stars
subject: Science
summary: Learn about our solar system - the Sun, eight planets, moons, asteroids, and comets. Understand the scale and structure of our cosmic neighborhood.

title: The Moon Phases Song | Waxing and Waning
subject: Science
summary: Learn about the phases of the moon - new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full moon, and waning phases. Understand why the moon appears to change shape.

title: The Eclipses Song | Solar and Lunar Eclipses
subject: Science
summary: Learn about solar and lunar eclipses. Understand how the alignment of the Sun, Earth, and Moon creates these spectacular celestial events.
